title: A Highly Efficient Diversity-based Input Selection for DNN Improvement Using VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2601.08024v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Maintaining or improving the performance of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) through fine-tuning requires labeling newly collected inputs, a process that is often costly and time-consuming. To alleviate this problem, input selection approaches have been developed in recent years to identify small, yet highly informative subsets for labeling. Diversity-based selection is one of the most effective approaches for this purpose. However, they are often computationally intensive and lack scalability for large input sets, limiting their practical applicability. To address this challenge, we introduce Concept-Based Diversity (CBD), a novel and highly efficient diversity metric for image inputs that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Our results show that CBD exhibits a strong correlation with Geometric Diversity (GD), an established diversity metric, while requiring only a fraction of its computation time. translated_title: 基于视觉语言模型的高效多样性输入选择方法用于深度神经网络改进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.08024v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：通过微调来维持或提升深度神经网络（DNN）的性能需要对新增收集的输入进行标注，这一过程通常成本高昂且耗时。为缓解此问题，近年来开发了输入选择方法，旨在识别小而信息量大的子集用于标注。基于多样性的选择是实现该目标最有效的方法之一。然而，这类方法通常计算密集，且对大规模输入集缺乏可扩展性，限制了其实际应用。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了基于概念多样性（CBD），一种新颖且高效的图像输入多样性度量，利用视觉语言模型（VLMs）。我们的结果表明，CBD与已建立的多样性度量——几何多样性（GD）展现出强相关性，同时仅需其计算时间的一小部分。基于此发现，我们...
tldr: 本文提出基于视觉语言模型的概念多样性（CBD）度量，以高效方式实现图像输入的多样性选择，与几何多样性（GD）强相关但计算成本极低，从而提升DNN微调的实用性和可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Concept-Based Diversity (CBD), a VLM-driven metric that efficiently selects diverse image inputs, strongly correlating with Geometric Diversity (GD) while requiring a fraction of its computation time, enhancing practical scalability for DNN fine-tuning.
